h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Thane

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Thane

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Thane

c: Thane is about 20 km from our factory in Vasai, so for many housing societies here we are close neighbours. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Thane for residential complexes, schools, corporate campuses and gardens run by the Thane Municipal Corporation. The large townships along Ghodbunder Road, and the older societies around the city's lakes, are among the places we supply.

Thane gets the full Mumbai monsoon, with very heavy rain from June to September, and humid air the rest of the year. Our Fun Fitness frames are galvanised pipe with roto-moulded parts, made in-house for exactly this weather. Our sales team can suggest machines from photos of your site. We send a layout drawing, manufacture after approval and install with our own team.

richText.heading: Fitting an open gym into a Thane society

c: Most Thane societies have a podium garden or a strip of lawn beside the compound wall. Both can take an outdoor gym, but a podium needs self-standing frames or careful anchoring that does not damage the waterproofing. Tell us which you have. The
6 Station Multi Gym
fits six exercises on one compact frame, and a
Ski Trainer
adds cardio work.
Keep a clear path between the gym and the children's play area so the two do not overlap. You can see one of our local installations on the
Raymond, Thane
project page. For the children's area, see our
playground equipment in Thane

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 20 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can outdoor gym machines be installed on a podium garden?
items.a: Often, yes. We look at the podium structure and waterproofing and suggest self-standing frames or a suitable fixing method. Share photos and drawings of the podium with our team.

items.q: How do the machines handle the Thane monsoon?
items.a: The frames are galvanised and the seats and handles are roto-moulded, so heavy rain does not cause rust. Keep the base drained and wipe the machines after long wet spells.
Three years on galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts, covering manufacturing defects with installation and care as we instruct.
